title: Captain Vane's quest text said 'do right by the Free Companies, then ask her about the road,' but immediately after resolving Rook (the exact favor she named) and returning to ask again, she repeated her original Rook briefing verbatim with no new option — the unlock only actually appeared later, after completing the unrelated, larger 'Hanged Company' quest. Cost a return trip (~9 turns) that produced nothing.
where: Captain Vane's Tent / 'the poacher skimming your tolls'
